title: Jubilant Light British Molasses Yorkshire Pudding
description: A light and energizing British dish featuring molasses, this dairy-free-friendly Yorkshire pudding is perfect for a satisfying meal, slow-cooked to perfection with a rich umami flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, molasses, salt, and black pepper.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the egg replacer and non-dairy milk.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
Heat the canola oil in a 12-cup Yorkshire pudding pan over medium heat.
Pour the batter into the prepared pan and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 20 minutes, then reduce the oven temperature to 375 degrees Fahrenheit and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the pudding from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
